$comment: The consumer layout contract (#1171): one visible clossys/ folder per repository. Native agent cell positions are listed under clossys/agents/<agent>/; other roles retain clossys/<role>/. Root clossys/ owns the package installation, configuration, generated README and machine state. Applications receive generated local source under apps/<app>/src/clossys/.

monorepoRootKey.description: A monorepo may place clossys/ inside a workspace package instead of the repository root by setting this key in its own package.json or a foundry.config.json at the repository root.

rules: One owner per folder: the declared Director, Designer, Writer and Publisher cell positions and the existing implemented Strategist native position are listed below. Other roles retain clossys/<role>/. No two roles write the same folder.
Visible, not hidden: these are the business's own records. Only machine files go under clossys/.state/; there is no separate .clossys/.
Removing a role removes its folder.
Monorepos: one configuration key (see monorepoRootKey) may place clossys/ inside a workspace package; the default is the repository root.

Declaration compatibility: safe owned descendants of clossys/<role>/ remain valid; only implemented CellAgent roles strategist, writer, designer and publisher additionally accept clossys/agents/<role>/. The separately retained Director position does not resolve Director/Strategist identity or migration, and compatibility enables no runtime legacy fallback.
clossys/package.json and clossys/clossys.config.ts are required. The package manifest is the only @clossys/* install site; applications consume generated local source at apps/<app>/src/clossys/.

folders.description: Existing implemented Strategist native cell root: tree.json, cells/<id>/v<N>.md and compiled strategy outputs. Recorded alongside the retained Director position without deciding role identity or migration.
The sole install site for @clossys/* packages.
Consumer configuration: identity, archetype, locales, targets, Studio and enabled agents.
Director tree.json and cells/<id>/v<N>.md; compiled strategy outputs stay in this agent folder.
Generated index: active roles, what each folder holds, last change. Rewritten on every launcher run; never hand-edited.
Roles this repository adopts or declines, with reasons (#395, #1168).

Why each role is staffed here, its goals, handoffs, and sequence, plus an optional snapshot of the hub's engagement context (fixed choice ids only, never founder text) so a role in a product repository reads what the founder already answered (docs/DECISIONS.md decision 28). The approved composed kit becomes this file (#1176). Written by the apply-plan step (#1178, wave 2); this entry is the layout position only.
Assessment input, plan, next action, PLAN.md. Exists on the account hub only, never on a product checkout.
Facts, audiences, positioning, claims, brand, direction. Replaces strategy/ at the repository root.
Copy registry, voice record. Authoring cells: tree.json and cells/<id>/v<N>.md.
Brand bindings, type record. Authoring cells: tree.json and cells/<id>/v<N>.md.
Route manifest, publication record. Append-only. Authoring cells: tree.json and cells/<id>/v<N>.md.
Surface documents owned by Publisher, referencing Designer and Writer records. Unlike append-only publication proof, these approved records are revised by reviewable diff.
Machine files: hub marker (workspace.json), inventory (inventory.json), skills manifest (skills.json, #1183). Not a place a person edits by hand.

App-local theme, component source closure, locale copy, routes, navigation, dependencies.json and .manifest.json. Generated text carries a do-not-edit header and body digest; it imports no @clossys/* packages.
Gitignored Studio run records, ports and writer lock.

gitPolicy.description: What gets committed, by kind of output. Approved records, proof, generated app-local source and persistent machine state are committed; generated run output and Studio runtime state are ignored.

rows.examples: strategy, copy, brand bindings, rules, plan
rows.note: every change is a reviewable diff
launcher writes .gitignore entries; convention is the owning role or agent folder followed by .generated/; Studio runtime state lives in clossys/.state/studio/

approval: Approval is a merged pull request, the same standing rule every skill already states -- a chat approved is not authorization. A consumer may route each role or agent folder through CODEOWNERS so the right person must approve its changes.

installPolicy.description: Install every @clossys/* package only through clossys/package.json. App package manifests and source must not depend on or import @clossys/*; generated app-local source declares its third-party dependencies separately.
